themes.description: Light values are the frontmatter. Dark and OLED override these CSS custom properties on :root; the header frame tokens (--header-*) never change.

headline.purpose: Page titles, including statute section headings.

title.purpose: Section headings within a page and dialog titles (1.25–1.35rem).

reading.purpose: Statute, act, and infraction text, in a reading column up to 54rem wide.

meta.purpose: Secondary lines, dates, counts, pane descriptions.

label.purpose: Uppercase status or provenance line above a heading; must carry information.

caption.purpose: Uppercase pills and tags; the interface's smallest size.

tab-label.purpose: Phone tab bar labels only (0.65rem, 700), following the platform tab-bar convention.

cssCustomProperties.--font-ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Phone chapter sheet rising from the bottom.

shadows.name: tab
shadows.purpose: The pane-collapse toggle over the pane edge.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: Every focusable element; --focus is #a86200 on light pages and #f0a202 on the dark frame and in dark themes.

motion.name: disclosure-turn
motion.purpose: Index topic chevrons rotating open; the system's only transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transitions and animations .01ms; scroll-behavior auto }

breakpoints.name: narrow-phone
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column cards and forms; acts table becomes cards.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Below: single column, bottom tab bar. Above: pane browser.

breakpoints.name: reading-container
breakpoints.purpose: Components inside the reading column stack when the column is narrow.

breakpoints.name: tab-labels
breakpoints.purpose: Tab bar drops to icons when the widest label no longer fits.

layout.readingColumnMin: 36rem (panes give way first); reading width up to 54rem

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled navy action, such as Bookmark, Copy link, Search, and Apply.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem .8rem; color: var(--on-blue, #fff); background: var(--blue, #0b3b70); border: 1px solid var(--blue, #0b3b70); border-radius: .25rem; font: 700 .875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark, #062b54); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #a86200); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined navy action beside filled ones, such as Email and Official source.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: .5rem .8rem; color: var(--blue, #0b3b70); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--blue, #0b3b70); border-radius: .25rem; font: 700 .875rem/1.2 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--blue-light, #dceafb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #a86200); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Search and filter fields; 3:1 edge on every surface.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .35rem; font: 700 .8125rem/1.3 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #172538); } .ds-field input { min-height: 3rem; padding: .7rem .85rem; color: var(--ink, #172538); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--field-line, #727d8a); border-radius: .25rem; font: 400 1rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #a86200); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Destinations on the dark frame; the current one is a light pill.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: .2rem; padding: .45rem .85rem; background: var(--app-header, #071525); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.55rem; padding: .45rem .7rem; color: var(--header-ink, #dce8f7); border-radius: .65rem; font: 700 .8125rem/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--header-accent-ink, #071525); background: var(--header-accent, #b8d7ff); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0a202; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: Supplement (blue) and repealed (amber) markers on sections.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .12rem .45rem; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 .75rem/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-pill-supp { color: var(--blue-dark, #062b54); background: var(--blue-light, #dceafb); border: 1px solid var(--blue, #0b3b70); } .ds-pill-repealed { color: var(--warning-ink, #4a3500); background: var(--warning-surface, #fff1d7); border: 1px solid var(--warning-line, #e2b45f); }

components.name: Callout
components.description: Tinted note with no stripe and no shadow, such as the supplement summary.
components.html: 2026 Supplement applied. 14 updated sections are labeled in the chapter list.
components.css: .ds-callout { max-width: 42rem; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; color: var(--blue-dark, #062b54); background: var(--blue-light, #dceafb); border-radius: .5rem; font: 400 1rem/1.55 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; }

components.name: Pane List Item
components.description: Section in the navigation pane; the current one is washed navy with a 4px leading marker.
components.html:
1. § 17b-237State aid toward support of children at center.
  2. § 17b-238State payments to hospitals.
components.css: .ds-pane { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; width: 15rem; background: var(--reader-surface, #eeeae1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-pane li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d8d5ce); } .ds-pane a { display: block; padding: .55rem .65rem; color: var(--ink, #172538); text-decoration: none; } .ds-pane a:hover { background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); } .ds-pane a[aria-current=page] { background: var(--blue-light, #dceafb); box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 var(--blue, #0b3b70); } .ds-pane strong { display: block; font-size: .8125rem; } .ds-pane span { display: block; margin-top: .12rem; color: var(--muted, #596777); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Statute Paragraph
components.description: Reading-font statute text with a subsection self-link and bold citation links.
components.html: (a) The Commissioner of Social Services shall establish annually the cost of services for which payment is to be made under the provisions of section 17b-239.
components.css: .ds-statute { max-width: 54rem; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #172538); font: 400 1.02rem/1.68 Georgia, 'Noto Serif', 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-sub { margin-right: .2rem; color: var(--blue, #0b3b70); font: 700 .875rem -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-cite { color: var(--blue, #0b3b70); font-weight: 700; text-underline-offset: .18em; } .ds-statute a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #a86200); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Amendment Marks
components.description: Inserted and struck language in acts and supplement comparisons.
components.html: payment shall be made within thirty days within fifteen days of receipt.
components.css: .ds-amend { max-width: 54rem; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #172538); font: 400 1.02rem/1.68 Georgia, 'Noto Serif', serif; } .ds-amend ins { color: var(--addition-ink, #14532d); background: var(--addition-surface, #dcfce7); text-decoration: none; } .ds-amend del { color: var(--deletion-ink, #991b1b); background: var(--deletion-surface, #fee2e2); text-decoration-thickness: .12em; }

narrative.overview:
A reading room is open to anyone, quiet, well lit, and has nothing for sale. This reader works the same way: warm paper surfaces, a book serif for the law itself, and an interface that steps back so the statute text sits at the center. A resident checking a ticket on a phone and a clerk pulling a citation at a desk get the same room. Nothing in the design asks for attention the text has not earned.

The mood is precise and trustworthy. Precision shows up as exact citations, provenance on every page, consistent states, and a fixed reading measure. Trust shows up as restraint: no gradients, no glows, no decorative motion. Color carries meaning (navy for action and the current place, blue for supplement changes, amber for repealed text and warnings, green and red for added and deleted language), never ornament.

The room is lit from the page, not the chrome. The dark header and tab bar are a frame; everything you read sits on Reading Room Paper or a white surface, flat, separated by hairlines and quiet tints. Shadows exist only for things that float above the page.
keyCharacteristics: Flat paper surfaces with hairline borders; tints, not shadows, group content.
Each device's own UI face for the interface; Georgia for statute and act text.
A wide reading column (up to 54rem) so a desktop screen holds more of each section; it never drops below 36rem beside the panes.
Color is semantic: navy acts, blue marks supplements, amber warns, green adds, red deletes.
A dark frame (header, tab bar) that never changes with theme; light, dark, and OLED themes for everything inside it.
Accessibility is structural: 3:1 boundaries on fields and focus, reading-comfort controls, screen-reader text for amendments.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Every hue says something: navy is action or "you are here", blue is a supplement change, amber is caution or repeal, green and red are added and deleted language. Never use one of these colors for decoration, and never introduce a hue without a meaning.

rules.name: The Twin Themes Rule
rules.body: Dark values exist twice, once for the Dark and OLED settings and once for Auto under `prefers-color-scheme`. Change both together; `test/theme.test.mjs` fails if they drift.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the interface is set below the caption size (0.75rem). The one exception is the phone tab bar's labels (0.65rem), which follow the platform tab-bar convention and whose icon-only cutoffs were measured against that size.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Use 400, 600, and 700 only. The system faces carry those weights; Windows renders 800 and above as Segoe UI Black.

rules.name: The Reading Column Rule
rules.body: Legal text runs up to 54rem wide so a desktop screen shows more of a section and needs less scrolling; beside the panes it never drops below 36rem, because the panes give way first. Headings and actions in the reader share that column so everything lines up. *(Chosen with the user: more text per screen over a short measure.)*

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. If a card needs separation, give it a border or a tint, not elevation. *(Confirmed with the user.)*

dos: **Do** take every color from a token; the header and tab bar use the frame tokens, which stay the same in every theme.
**Do** keep statute, act, and infraction text in the Reading font, in the reading column (up to 54rem).
**Do** set sizes from the role tokens (caption 0.75rem, meta 0.8125rem, ui 0.875rem, small reading 0.9375rem, body 1rem).
**Do** use a 3px Signal Amber focus outline, #a86200 on page surfaces and #f0a202 on the dark frame.
**Do** give every input and select a Field Edge (#727d8a) border.
**Do** show selection on page surfaces as a navy fill with on-navy text, and in the header as a Header Accent pill.
**Do** mark supplement changes in blue, repealed text and warnings in amber, and amendments in green and red, with screen-reader text for each.
**Do** let outer navigation panes give way before the reading column drops below 36rem.
donts: **Don't** put a resting shadow on cards or panels; shadows are for floating layers only.
**Don't** add colored side stripes to callouts, cards, or alerts. Use a tint, plus a full 1px border for warnings and errors.
**Don't** ship a webfont for the default interface, or use weights above 700.
**Don't** set interface text below 0.75rem; the tab bar labels are the only exception.
**Don't** add gradients, glows, or decorative motion.
**Don't** add a label above a heading that only repeats the heading. Labels carry status, counts, or provenance.
**Don't** change a dark-theme token in one block without the other.
